## RE:volution Mod v1.3.7

### Added

- Per-physical-managed-mob damage contribution tracking for Location/Mob Spawn runtime instances.
- Proportional managed-mob rewards based on each current participant's effective damage contribution.
- Per-player reward bonuses are applied after proportional base reward splitting.
- Max-contributor resolution for future progression: largest current contribution wins, with exact ties awarded to the player who reached the tied contribution first.
- HP rollback when a contributor is no longer eligible for the mob zone: their contribution is removed and exactly that damage is restored, capped at the mob's max HP.

### Fixed

- Overkill can no longer inflate contribution or reward share beyond the managed mob's remaining virtual HP.
- Players who leave the mob zone, disconnect, or change dimension no longer retain a reward/progression claim for that combat attempt.
- New respawns and unloaded/reloaded physical mob slots start with full HP and an empty contribution table.

### Compatibility

- Legacy Realm 0 managed mobs without Location/Mob Spawn configuration retain their existing last-hit reward behavior.
- Existing FIXED_POINT/RANDOM_AREA respawn, ROAMING separation, combat pause, safe-surface rules and Realm isolation remain unchanged.
- Poison player damage participates in contribution accounting but does not trigger the direct-hit roaming pause.
- Mongo progression/gating is intentionally not added in this release; v1.3.7 only establishes the runtime winner needed by the next progression stage.

### Download

The release build will produce `RE-volution-1.3.7.jar` after runtime acceptance and release promotion.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.6...v1.3.7
